#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> fact;
vector<int> ifact;

int fmul(int a, int b) {
    return (int)((long long)a * b % MOD);
}

int fpow(int a, int b) {
    if (a == 0) return 0;
    int ans = 1;
    while (b > 0) {
        if (b & 1) ans = fmul(ans, a);
        a = fmul(a, a);
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return ans;
}

int ifact_cached(int x) {
    if (ifact[x] > 0) return ifact[x];
    return ifact[x] = fpow(fact[x], MOD - 2);
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    long long kl;
    cin >> n >> kl;

    if (kl >= n) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }

    int k = (int)kl;
    fact.resize(n + 1);
    ifact.resize(n + 1, 0);
    fact[0] = fact[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        fact[i] = fmul(fact[i - 1], i);
    }

    int res = 0;
    for (int i = 0, sign = 1; i <= n - k; ++i, sign = -sign) {
        int comb = fmul(fact[n - k], fmul(ifact_cached(i), ifact_cached(n - k - i)));
        int powVal = fpow(n - k - i, n);
        int term = fmul(comb, powVal);
        if (sign == 1) {
            res += term;
        } else {
            res -= term;
        }
        if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
        if (res < 0) res += MOD;
    }

    res = fmul(res, fact[n]);
    res = fmul(res, ifact_cached(k));
    res = fmul(res, ifact_cached(n - k));
    if (k != 0) {
        res = fmul(res, 2);
    }

    cout << res << endl;
    return 0;
}
